entries.{{name}}: The value of name, escaped for HTML: < becomes <.
entries.{{{name}}}: The value as it is, with no HTML escaping.
entries.{{& name}}: The value with no HTML escaping, another spelling; handy once the delimiters have changed.
entries.{{a.b}}: A nested value, by a dotted path.
entries.{{missing}}: A value the view does not hold gives nothing, and no error.
entries.{{#list}}…{{/list}}: A section repeated for each item of a non-empty list.
entries.{{#flag}}…{{/flag}}: A section shown if the value is true, hidden if it is false, null or empty.
entries.{{#object}}…{{/object}}: A section that steps into an object: its keys are read without a prefix.
entries.{{^list}}…{{/list}}: An inverted section: shown if the list is empty or the value false.
entries.{{.}}: The current item of a list of plain values.
entries.{{> partial}}: A partial template, included here with the same view.
entries.{{=<% %>=}}: Changes the delimiters, when {{ }} already belongs to the text.
